findings.title: Cook eligibility is inferred from a separate, potentially incomplete recipe read
findings.origin: Partial remediation of existing A18; the candidate adds the independent frame recipe read and length-based gate.

location.detail: Cook is offered when the frame read contains any ingredient or instruction entry.

evidence.detail: The frame independently reads the projection-provided recipe href.
The body reads the same href independently; on failure line 170 renders RegionFailure without RecipeExperience.
On overview, the button only scrolls to recipe-experience and dispatches rezics-cook.
Only a mounted RecipeExperience installs the cook event listener.
The transport creates an AbortController signal per attempt and fetches with cache no-store; sharing a cached client is not sharing the recipe result.
The owner returns one bounded pinned page with optional next; ingredients are not an execution capability.
Instructions are resolved only for this page of occurrences.
An instruction entry may explicitly have status unavailable.
CookMode renders only the currently loaded ingredients and steps and provides no continuation control.

concreteCounterexamples: Both projection reads identify Recipe and disclose the same recipe href. The frame recipe request succeeds with one ingredient. The overview request returns unavailable (503). The header offers Cook, but the body has only RegionFailure, no recipe-experience node and no event listener. Clicking Cook performs no task. Reversing those responses hides Cook while usable body data is present.

A bounded first page has one ingredient, instructions: [], and next pointing to later instructions. The length gate offers Cook before those pages are loaded; its modal has an empty Method and no Show more. An instructions array containing only unavailable entries also passes the same gate.
findings.impact: The advertised primary Recipe task can do nothing or open an incomplete/unavailable method. The original Cook-availability concern remains open despite the new null/empty guard.
findings.classSweep: Applies to global and Zone Work frames on all tabs and their cross-view #cook links; recipe body, shared RecipeExperience and editor preview consumption were inspected. Count-based availability must not be copied to any of those surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Derive the action and displayed task from the same exact owner-selected recipe result. Treat missing, denied, unavailable, incomplete continuation and unavailable instruction selections explicitly. Expose or consume an owner-defined task capability if the client cannot determine executability; do not promote array length into business policy.
findings.validationGap: No live or browser assertion exercised these response combinations. The scratch probe did not target this finding.

location.detail: Work facts use standaloneHrefFor({}, entityHref(id)), including continuation links.

evidence.detail: Pages exposes nextCursor with no current cursor.

When the resource is a Work, permanentRedirect only preserves its /w address, not the query/cursor.
